messages:
sara (AE): Heads up — AuroraPay POC is flaking. They report intermittent connection timeouts to our private endpoint since ~09:10 PT. Carmen pasted client logs.

carmen (Customer - AuroraPay): here's the client error: `curl: (28) Operation timed out after 30000 milliseconds with 0 bytes received` hitting 10.12.34.56:443 from their on-prem.

matt (SE): Can you paste the curl command + --trace? Are they going through a corporate proxy/NAT?

carmen (Customer - AuroraPay): `curl -v https://10.12.34.56/api/v1/health --connect-timeout 30` — from office it times out, from an AWS bastion it succeeds.

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] private-edge-2 rollout completed at 2026-02-14T08:50Z

jen (SRE): I'm checking egress NAT and LB health. No 5xx from our side. I do see a cluster of SYN_RECV -> SYN_TIMEOUTs around 09:09-09:12 PT from the AuroraPay IP range.

liam (sales-eng): Pricing ask from the customer: can POC credits transfer to a reserved capacity commit if they convert? Need an answer for renewal convo.

nina (solutions): Also SSQ: they requested official egress IP ranges and evidence of SOC2 controls for private deployments. We'll need legal on this.

sara (AE): @jen can you pull packet captures for that IP range? @carmen can you run traceroute + mtr from the failing host? Also propose we enable a short fallback to hosted to keep the demo moving.

carmen (Customer - AuroraPay): traceroute output attached in thread — shows timeout at hop 6, then * * * beyond.

matt (SE): traceroute shows a mid-path drop. Possible PMTU / MSS clamping or carrier blackhole. Any recent firewall rule changes on their side?

jen (SRE): I'll spin up tcpdump on the edge host for those source IPs. Mitigation options: increase retry timeout client-side or enable temporary host-level fallback to hosted for 30–120m.

sara (AE): Agreed. @nina tell them we'll do fallback and provide an RCA within 24 hours. Also confirm the credits question.

nina (solutions): I can confirm conversion policy by EOD — short answer: we can credit toward committed for a limited window, need legal/SOW update.

fred (legal): SOC2 attestation is available; we can share a redacted report after NDA. Egress IPs for private are not public but we can generate a time-limited allowlist file for them.

matt (SE): I've started a tcpdump — seeing SYN out, no SYN+ACK back for a subset of packets. Carmen, can you attempt `curl --interface <local-ip> -v` from another internal host?

carmen (Customer - AuroraPay): Tried from a different office host, still times out. From AWS transit gateway it succeeds.

jen (SRE): That strongly indicates a carrier or on-prem network path issue. Plan: 1) apply fallback route to hosted for AuroraPay for 2 hours; 2) share tcpdump + traceroute with their carrier; 3) schedule joint triage with their network ops at 10:30 PT; 4) produce RCA + SSQ artifacts.

sara (AE): Matt, can you apply the fallback route? I'll open an FAF for the window.

matt (SE): Applied route policy — AuroraPay origin prefix routed to hosted for 120m. Monitoring now.

ops-bot: [route-bot] route policy change applied by matt at 09:30 PT

carmen (Customer - AuroraPay): After routing to hosted, requests succeed. Can you confirm auth tokens and headers are preserved on the hosted path?

matt (SE): Tokens preserved, header passthrough intact. Note: latency is up ~40ms on hosted path, flagged in the demo script.

nina (solutions): Pricing update: if they convert from POC to Dedicated within 45 days we can hold POC per-unit price for first 3 months. I'll follow up via email with terms.

fred (legal): NDA sent to Carmen via DocuSign. I'll also prepare redacted audit artifacts and a short SOW amendment template for committed capacity.

sara (AE): Meeting scheduled 10:30 PT with AuroraPay netops. Owners: matt (tech lead), jen (SRE), nina (sales ops). RCA ETA 24h.

matt (SE): I'll attach the tcpdump and traceroute to the meeting notes. Also adding a quick mitigation doc for the hosted fallback.

carmen (Customer - AuroraPay): Appreciate the quick response — thanks team :pray:

nina (solutions): I'll draft the handoff summary and SSQ checklist before the meeting.

sara (AE): Marking this as resolved for the live demo. Monitor for recurrence and update thread with any anomalies. :thumbsup:
